name: 한글 문서
description: 프로젝트의 HWP와 HWPX 문서를 rhwp-studio 편집기로 열어 고치고 같은 형식으로 저장한다.

status.name: hwp.document
status.description: The open document: its path relative to the project root, its format hwp or hwpx, the SHA-256 version of the last read or write, whether the editor holds unsaved edits as modified, whether it holds a selection, the number of pages of the last load, and whether the file on disk is the same or changed.

commands.name: hwp.save
commands.description: Exports the document of the editor in its own format and writes it in place when the file on disk still has the version that the surface read; with overwrite, writes over the version that changed on disk. Failures are shown as the tab's error.

commands.name: hwp.reload
commands.description: Reads the file again into the editor and discards unsaved edits.

commands.name: hwp.request
commands.description: Sends an embed request of rhwp-studio, such as automation.context or getPageSvg, with its params to the editor and returns its result.

dom.name: hwp.banner
dom.description: The line that states that the file changed on disk.

dom.name: hwp.reload
dom.description: The button that reads the file again.

dom.name: hwp.overwrite
dom.description: The button that writes over the file that changed on disk.

dom.name: hwp.studio
dom.description: The document region that shows rhwp-studio.
